create_PunicaWrapperBase: create a PunicaWrapperBase instance with max batches, token limits, and device
update_PunicaWrapper_metadata: update LoRA metadata with mapping, index-to-id, max loras, and vocab size
call_add_lora_linear: call add_lora_linear to apply LoRA weights through shrink and expand GEMM operations
call_add_lora_logits: call add_lora_logits to apply LoRA for LogitsProcessorWithLoRA forward pass
call_add_lora_fused_moe: call add_lora_fused_moe to perform fused LoRA forward for MoE layers
